_comment: These servers require external CLIs installed on PATH (nexus, uvx, egc-memory-mcp, longhand) or proprietary paths. Install the CLI first before enabling.

nexus.description: Local cost/privacy proxy - query your own usage & savings, route to the cheapest capable model, and mask secrets/PII before egress (nexus_stats, nexus_savings, nexus_recent, nexus_providers, nexus_cost_breakdown)

ito-compute.description: Opt-in local Itô compute MCP. The canonical package is unpublished and must be built from Ito-Markets/ito-cloud-runtime/cli/ito-compute-cli. Exposes ito_auth, ito_find, ito_status, and ito_accept. ito_auth validates existing credentials; it does not start device login. Use egc ito login [--no-browser] for device authorization, which stores tokens in macOS Keychain by default; explicit file fallback must retain owner-only settings. EGC itself performs no browser automation. ITO_API_KEY is forwarded directly to auth, find, status, and accept when configured; ITO_AUTH_MODE=legacy is not required.

jira.description: Jira issue tracking — search, create, update, comment, transition issues

egc-memory-vault.description: Opt-in local EGC Memory Vault shared by Gemini, Codex, Hermes, Cursor, OpenCode, and other MCP clients. Replace EGC_MEMORY_HARNESS with this server's lowercase identity; callers cannot override it. Normal search recall is active project+team memory. To permit explicitly requested user scope, the operator may also set EGC_MEMORY_ALLOW_USER_SCOPE=1. Writes are create-only and always unreviewed. Install EGC globally or make its bin available on PATH. Not enabled by default.

omega-memory.description: Persistent agent memory with semantic search, multi-agent coordination, and knowledge graphs — run via uvx (richer than the basic memory store)

longhand.description: Lossless Gemini CLI / Antigravity session history — indexes raw tool calls, file edits, and thinking blocks from ~/.gemini/projects/*.jsonl into local SQLite + ChromaDB before Gemini CLI / Antigravity rotates them. Complements memory/omega-memory (synthesized) with verbatim recall. Install: pip install longhand && longhand setup
